scene_design: Independent joined L building with unequal wings, ochre masonry, faded sage/graphite cladding, stepped level roofs, human door and shutter into inner court. About55% roof coverage. Add CASSETTE FUTURISM to EVERY mechanical device and both vehicles: bulky removable cartridge modules, recessed analog gauges, tactile key banks, ribbed shells, smoked amber indicators, hinged service bays and chunky connectors. Diverse shapes: horizontal rounded pods, flat rack control banks, tall narrow consoles, broad vented boxes. Mix aged olive, brown, charcoal, warm-grey and limited ivory, avoid repeated white boxes/orange handles. Preserve salvaged repairs and functional connections; design car/motorcycle as analog retrofuturist machines, not modern cars with decals. Place each vehicle and snapped pole in separate peripheral bays, never in central space or exit routes. No green screens.
